# Time scales as a tower of discrete readings

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Each level reads the next finer one at strictly increasing times, and balance (each relatum listed once) and dissipation pass to coarser levels. At any level, with what stands not refuted to run down at each fine step, a coarsest stretch has no more falls of total standing than its starting total.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

A tower (Tower): at each level a web and a flow, level n being level n+1 read at the strictly increasing times refine n (web_sample, flow_sample). Step s of the coarsest level is step reads n s of level n; the coarsest level is level n read at those times (Tower.web_zero, Tower.level_zero), which are strictly increasing (Tower.reads_strict). Laws at every level: balance with each relatum listed once, and dissipation, pass to the coarser level (Tower.balances_coarser, Tower.dissipative_coarser). Change bounded however finely divided: a stretch of N steps of the coarsest level from S, read at level n, under a census of what stands at level n and with what stands not refuted to run down at each of its fine steps, has at most as many fine steps at which the total standing falls, the steps at which some standing changes, as the coarsest level's total standing at S (Tower.changes_within); the bound does not depend on n.

Canonical source: [Tower.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Tower.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No global premise: running down and the census only at the level and fine steps used.
- Representation: time as a family of discrete readings linked by the reading of Sampling (Ren's decision of 12 October); the core takes no real numbers.

Ren decided on 12 October that continuous time is built in the core as a tower of ever-finer discrete readings, a law of continuous time being a law at every level, real-valued time a later periphery correspondence. This result gives the tower and its first law: dividing time more finely adds no change. It rests on the laws of one step (Flow.runsDown_bounds_change) and the least loss per exchange, with no premise added.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 6 theorems of the new core module Becoming.Tower all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. It was first compiled from the prelude in a scratch tree, with no warnings and every #print axioms empty. The core closure is 49 modules. There is no independent review yet; the author's counterreview is in §82 of the integration note.

Not done: real-valued time (a periphery correspondence); towers with no coarsest level; the exact form of the bound as levels refine. The count uses a census; running down is a condition at the level used. The names (Tower, reads, refine) are the AI's.

- Boundary: the bound needs what stands to run down at the fine steps. In Strobe a relatum arises and ceases at fine steps inside every coarse step while every sampling time is quiet (Strobe.converse_fails): without running down, a finer level can show unbounded change that a coarser one does not.
